remarks: Expansive canyon views, generous living spaces, and a private cul-de-sac setting welcome you to 2 Via Cancion in Talega’s sought-after Miraleste neighborhood. Tucked at the end of the cul-de-sac on an approximately 6,585-square-foot lot, this home enjoys a sense of privacy and openness that makes its setting especially memorable. Approximately 3,364 square feet includes five bedrooms, three full bathrooms, a large bonus room, and a three-car garage. A large, open-concept living and dining room create an inviting introduction, with ample room for conversation, holiday dinners, and gatherings with friends.
